'''Sapir tea''' was a variety of [[Tea/Legends|tea]] available during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Made from the leaves of the [[sapir]] [[Plant/Legends|plant]], the beverage was green in [[Color/Legends|color]] and had a rich, aromatic smell. It was a favorite of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]].<ref name="SOTJ" /> In [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of the first part of [[Secrets of the Jedi (novel)|''Secrets of the Jedi'']], in which [[sapir]] [[Tea/Legends|tea]] appears, to [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]].</ref> after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Jinn's dear friend and fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Tahl]], Jinn's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] brought him sapir tea early every [[Local day/Legends|morning]] during their stay in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] as a way to console him.<ref name="SOTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sapir tea appeared in [[Secrets of the Jedi (novel)|''Secrets of the Jedi'']], a [[2005]] young readers novel by [[Jude Watson]].<ref name="SOTJ" />
